jobs.description: This is a general management role with full ownership of the Australian 3P Marketplace. You will lead a cross-functional team spanning account management, program management, and seller operations, owning a significant and rapidly scaling P&L. Your job: grow selection strategically, transform the operating model through AI and automation, and make Amazon.com.au the obvious choice for Australian Sellers. You’ll define the strategy, build the team, and deliver the results — with the autonomy to move fast and the accountability that comes with it. This role is based in Sydney, Australia and reports into the VP of International Seller Services. Key job responsibilities Growth & Strategy • Strategy & Vision: Define and own the 3P Marketplace strategy for Australia. Set the ambition, align stakeholders, and make the hard trade-offs between selection breadth, Seller quality, and speed to market. • Selection & Seller Acquisition: Strategically grow the Australian catalogue by recruiting high-value Selling Partners and driving adoption of FBA, Advertising, Brand Registry, and other key programs. Turn Australia into a destination marketplace for top local and international brands. • P&L Ownership: Own a complex P&L end-to-end. Drive sustainable, profitable growth while balancing investment in long-term capability building. • Negotiations & Partnerships: Personally lead negotiations with top Australian and international brands to bring them onto the platform as 3P Sellers. Transformation & Innovation • AI & Automation: Lead the transformation of the Australia 3P organization to be AI-first — automating Seller queries, operational reporting, WBRs/QBRs, and decision-making based on Seller performance, inputs, and cost to serve. Set the standard for what a modern marketplace team looks like. • Seller Experience (SX): Reimagine the end-to-end Seller journey — from onboarding to listing to account health — removing friction and building tools that let Sellers scale without hand-holding. • Customer Experience (CX): Raise the bar on what 3P Sellers deliver to customers: faster delivery, better product quality, seamless returns. Close the gap between 1P and 3P experience. • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with regional and global teams (Retail, Product, Technology, Operations) to co-develop programs, influence product roadmaps, and scale what works beyond Australia. People & Influence • Team Leadership: Build, develop, and retain a high-performing team of account managers and program managers. Set a high bar for talent, coach leaders, and create an environment where people do their best work. • PR & Public Policy: Be the external voice of Amazon’s marketplace in Australia — championing the story that Amazon empowers small- and medium-sized businesses to grow and reach more customers. About the team Since 1994, Amazon has continuously expanded its product selection and innovated on behalf of customers in an ongoing effort to fulfill its stated ambition of being earth’s most customer-centric company. Amazon strives to become a destination where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want — low prices, vast selection, and convenience — we continue to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon’s Third-Party (3P) Marketplace plays a critical role in this mission by enabling every trustworthy Seller to provide the best customer experience and grow successfully. In Australia, the 3P Marketplace is a key growth engine, and we are looking for a dynamic, customer-obsessed leader to drive the next phase of growth for our Australian Selling Partners. Why This Role, Why Now: The Australian 3P Marketplace has reached an exciting inflection point. With strong foundational momentum, the opportunity now is to accelerate — expanding selection at pace, embedding AI and automation into the operating model, and establishing Australia as a benchmark for how modern marketplace teams operate. This role offers the chance to shape that next chapter with real ownership, global support, and the mandate to move decisively.

Scopely's Security team is looking for a Sr Client Security Engineer to build a new client security function in China. You will design and ship client/server-side protections for large-scale mobile games, combat sophisticated cheating ecosystems, and help ensure fair play for tens of millions of players.

What You Will Do

• Build, and grow the Client Security team in China, setting China specific technical direction, and operational best practices.
• Design, implement, and maintain client-side detections against third‑party cheating tools, modified clients, hooking frameworks, and emulators on Android and iOS.
• Own the client security integration into Scopely's internal anti-cheat platforms working closely with teams to ensure detections are actionable and scalable.
• Define and evolve the obfuscation and hardening strategy for China mobile builds (e.g., binary protection, anti-debugging, anti-tamper, integrity checks), including evaluating and integrating third‑party hardening vendors where appropriate.
• Build and maintain strong coverage for the China mobile ecosystem, including:

• distribution through multiple Android app stores and OEM devices,
• diverse OS/ROM variants and rooted/jailbroken environments,
• and local PC/emulator-based cheating patterns.

• Contribute hands-on code (C++ plus Java/Kotlin and/or Objective‑C/Swift) in security‑sensitive paths, including detection logic, integrity checks, and secure client–server protocols.

What You Will Need

• Experience in mobile security, game anti-cheat, or client-side security engineering, including time working directly on Android or iOS native code.
• Direct experience with reverse engineering.
• Deep hands-on experience with:

• Android and IOS internals
• hooking and instrumentation frameworks,
• and common mobile client security attack vectors.

• Strong proficiency in C/C++ and at least one mobile native language (Java/Kotlin for Android or Objective‑C/Swift for iOS), including experience shipping production code in large apps.
• Demonstrated experience designing and shipping client-side anti-cheat or integrity systems that integrate with server-side enforcement or analytics pipelines.
• Prior experience ing or technically directing a small engineering team
• Experience working with large-scale telemetry or anti-abuse pipelines and using data to tune detections and reduce false positives.
• Professional proficiency in both Mandarin and English, written and spoken
• Requires five days per week in the office
• Requires relocation to Tokyo

Bonus Points

• BS / MS in Computer Science or Software Engineering or equivalent
• Experience shipping and securing mobile games or other large-scale consumer apps specific to the China market, specific exposure to:

• multiple Android app-store ecosystems and OEM variations,
• desktop/mobile emulator usage patterns,
• and tooling development experience specific for china mobile games

• Previous CTF experience, and CVE contributing experience
• Prior work on client obfuscation / hardening pipelines, including vendor evaluation and integration, and handling performance and stability tradeoffs.
• Familiarity with large-scale cloud environments, streaming data processing, and monitoring/alerting

jobs.description: Amazon’s Intermodal (AZIM) Operations team is seeking highly skilled and motivated Transportation Specialists to join this rapidly growing team. AZIM Operations drives the end to end operational execution of all loads (internal and external) shipped on our 1P network. The team supports regions and shippers across the Supply Chain network and is tasked with ensuring on-time pickup and delivery of freight from vendors, Amazon fulfillment centers (FCs), rail yards and shipper hubs. In the case of disruptions, the Operations team is responsible for addressing the disruption, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring timely resolution of the issue. The AZIM Operations team is the first line of defense in understanding network trends, delays, dwells and other exceptions that impact AZIM’s ability to deliver a world class transportation product that serves its customers on time. An ideal candidate has a background in customer service/call center, transportation, and/or supply chain environments. Additionally, a passion for quickly providing solutions and resolution to challenges by using strong communication, problem solving and organizational skills is a must. Successful candidates will enjoy working in a fast-pace, high-volume call center environment with a lot of growth opportunity. They will thrive on accountability to themselves, team, carriers/drivers and work schedules! Key job responsibilities -Deliver excellent carrier and driver experience/solutions, in a high-volume contact center environment, through researching, problem-solving, setting appropriate expectations and working within the Amazon Transportation network to get trailers/trucks back on track when disruptions occur - Work in fast-paced environment, and adhere to schedules: start/stop, and breaks/lunches - Support workload surges and/or weather-related operations as needed to include working significant overtime during designated high-volume peaks - Use internal systems to gather data from multiple sources to support reporting on a daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly basis - Provide support to field teams and partners by creating repair requests, monitoring load execution, ensuring on-time pickup and delivery metrics - Work with cross-functional teams. Use analytical skills to drive data-driven decision, and effectively communicate insights to others across Transportation Operations Management, Amazon Freight Shippers, rail partners, Carriers, and Fleet - Provide support to drivers and carriers with over the road disruptions Your calls will be monitored and recorded for training and compliance purposes. A day in the life The AZIM Transportation Operations Specialist facilitates the continued flow of Amazon’s supply chain by passing information to key stakeholders and resolving disruptions that impact customer experience or the flow of information impacting performance and delivery. The Specialist addresses or escalates any concerns arising during the lifecycle of freight leaving rail ramps, shipper hubs, Amazon fulfillment centers, or transiting between rail to OTR carriers. The day-to day role requires the specialist to provide resolutions by researching and querying internal tools and making real-time decisions in accordance with their guidance and standard work processes. In this role, the Transportation Operations Specialist will be able to understand the process and requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. This position will need to have the experience to understand Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡의 Global Investigations Team(글로벌 조사팀)은 쿠팡 그룹 전체의 조사 업무를 전담하는 조직으로, 쿠팡 및 국내외 계열사에서 발생할 수 있는 사기(Fraud), 비위행위(Misconduct), 정책 위반(Policy Violations) 및 기타 비윤리적 행위와 관련된 리스크를 식별, 평가 및 완화하는 역할을 수행합니다. 글로벌 조사팀은 윤리 제보 채널을 관장하고, 이를 통해 접수된 윤리 위반 사안에 대해 독립적이고 객관적인 조사를 수행하며, 사실관계를 규명하고 적절한 조치 및 개선 방안을 도출합니다. 또한 해외 자회사의 조사 활동을 지원하고, 그룹 차원의 조사 기준과 운영 원칙이 일관되게 적용될 수 있도록 총괄합니다.

현재 쿠팡 글로벌 조사팀에서는 Principal 조사 전문가를 채용하고 있습니다. 본 포지션은 복잡하고 민감한 조사 사안을 독립적으로 평가하고 수행하며, 우수한 판단력과 분석력을 바탕으로 조사 전 과정을 주도할 수 있는 전문가를 대상으로 합니다.

jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY: The key strategic focus within the Internal Medicine Research Unit (IMRU) is identifying novel therapies to prevent or treat metabolic diseases such as obesity and cardiovascular disease. Our goal is to build a world-class research team of dedicated scientists committed to developing a deep mechanistic understanding of the metabolic pathways underlying disease pathogenesis. As a senior scientific leader and member of the obesity discovery biology team, this individual will play a significant role in shaping the scientific direction for the obesity therapeutic area and influencing broader IMRU research strategy and portfolio priorities. The individual will help create and drive discovery research strategy across multiple programs, including target ideation, validation, translational biomarker strategy, hypothesis testing, and early clinical development within the IMRU obesity portfolio. The successful candidate will lead through both direct team leadership and influence across multidisciplinary partners, helping align scientific decisions across discovery biology, translational sciences, clinical, computational, and external collaborators. The individual will identify emerging therapeutic opportunities, advance portfolio programs with scientific rigor and urgency, and represent research strategies to internal leadership and the external scientific community. Knowledge and experience in the study of metabolic pathways are essential, and familiarity with the pathophysiology of dysmetabolic states would be advantageous. Strong self-motivation, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to lead, mentor, and build scientific capability in a highly collaborative environment are essential. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES: Shape and influence the scientific direction for discovery research programs aligned with IMRU therapeutic area and portfolio strategy. Apply creative thinking and scientific expertise to formulate strategies that identify, prioritize, and validate therapeutic targets in key areas of interest to the Internal Medicine Research Unit. Maintain awareness of cutting-edge scientific and technical developments in preclinical-to-clinical translation and apply these insights to advance portfolio programs and identify emerging opportunities. Guide research priorities across multiple programs by integrating mechanistic biology, translational feasibility, biomarker strategy, and portfolio impact. Conceptualize, design, and oversee rigorous in vivo, ex vivo, and in vitro studies, including experimental design, data collection, interpretation, and presentation. Quantify and translate experimental results to advance understanding of how metabolic pathways and complex physiological systems are altered by disease and respond to therapeutic intervention. Lead a research team of lab heads and scientists, providing supervision, coaching, and mentorship to develop skills essential to rigorous scientific research and drug discovery execution. Lead through influence across multidisciplinary teams and key stakeholders, driving scientific alignment and decision-making where accountability extends beyond direct reporting lines. Build and facilitate strategic collaborations with partners in the academic scientific community, the broader Pfizer network, and external experts to strengthen scientific insight and portfolio impact. Establish external scientific leadership through peer-reviewed publications, scientific presentations, conference engagement, and thought leadership in relevant areas of metabolic disease biology. Present and represent research programs, portfolio recommendations, and scientific strategy to Pfizer leadership and governance forums. Ensure that all research and discovery work is conducted with the highest quality and ethical standards and in accordance with relevant regulatory, QC, and compliance guidelines. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: PhD, MD, or MD/PhD with postdoctoral research experience and 12+ years of experience leading research groups and supervising scientists in an industry or academic setting. Successful track record of scientific achievement through high-impact publications, presentations, and recognized contributions to the scientific community. Demonstrated ability to critically review complex data, think creatively, formulate novel hypotheses, and translate scientific insight into actionable discovery strategy. Deep expertise in metabolism and/or signaling pathways relevant to obesity (CNS neurocircuitry or peripheral metabolism), with the ability to apply mechanistic insight to therapeutic target identification and validation. Experience performing and/or leading in vitro, in vivo, and ex vivo experiments relevant to metabolic disease biology. Demonstrated ability to influence multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders, including the ability to drive decisions and align priorities without direct authority. Demonstrated ability to contribute to and advance multiple projects in parallel with learning agility, scientific rigor, and portfolio-level judgment. Experience developing scientific talent through mentorship, coaching, and building organizational capability. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to represent research strategy and portfolio recommendations to scientific, governance, and leadership audiences. Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS: Some travel to scientific conferences and other Pfizer sites expected. ADDITIONAL DETAILS: Last date to apply is October 8, 2026 Work Location Assignment: This is a hybrid role requiring you to live within commuting distance and work on-site an average of 2.5 days per week. The annual base salary for this position ranges from $162,900.00 to $271,500.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility. Candidates must be authorized to be employed in the U.S. by any employer. U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O-1, H-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future. Sommaire du poste Relevant de la Directrice Principale, Gestion de la performance de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et gouvernance, le/la Gestionnaire principal(e), Gouvernance et optimisation du portefeuille est responsable de la gouvernance, des analyses de performance et du soutien à la prise de décision pour les leviers détenus par les Opérations d’approvisionnement. Le rôle assure une supervision intégrée de la performance des niveaux de service, de la gouvernance du cycle de vie des fournisseurs et des produits, de l’optimisation du portefeuille et de l’habilitation logistique, tout en garantissant une exécution rigoureuse, l’intégrité des données et une visibilité adéquate pour la direction. Le poste établit et opère des cadres de gouvernance soutenant l’intégration des fournisseurs, les processus d’inscription et de retrait des produits, ainsi que les décisions liées au cycle de vie des produits, tout en traduisant des intrants opérationnels et analytiques complexes en informations claires et prêtes pour les décideurs exécutifs. Grâce à une collaboration transversale étroite avec les équipes de Planification, d’Approvisionnement stratégique, de Logistique entrante, des Opérations des centres de distribution, des TI et d’Analytique, le/la Gestionnaire principal(e) anticipe les risques, mène l’amélioration continue et assure l’alignement entre la gouvernance, l’exécution et les engagements en matière de niveau de service. Section A – Responsabilités spécifiques Performance du niveau de service et habilitation de la gouvernance Assurer la responsabilité des analyses de performance, des indicateurs et de la gouvernance liés aux leviers d’exécution et au niveau de service, en identifiant les risques, les tendances et les opportunités d’amélioration structurelle dans le périmètre sous responsabilité. Anticiper de façon proactive les impacts sur le niveau de service découlant des décisions des Opérations d’approvisionnement et définir, en partenariat avec la Planification, la Logistique entrante et les Opérations des centres de distribution, des plans d’atténuation fondés sur l’analyse des données. Traduire des analyses complexes en messages clairs et prêts pour les exécutifs, en présentant les arbitrages, les causes fondamentales et des recommandations appuyées par les données afin de soutenir la prise de décision de la haute direction de la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Définir et opérationnaliser un modèle de gouvernance de la performance pour les Opérations d’approvisionnement, incluant les définitions des KPI, la cadence de reddition de comptes, les mécanismes d’escalade et les forums de revue avec la direction. Collaborer avec les équipes TI et Analytique pour améliorer les rapports, tableaux de bord et la visibilité de la performance, soutenant ainsi la gouvernance, les revues de leadership et la qualité durable des décisions. Gestion et gouvernance du cycle de vie des fournisseurs Définir et faire évoluer les cadres de gouvernance soutenant l’inscription et l’intégration des fournisseurs. Assurer l’alignement des activités liées au cycle de vie des fournisseurs avec les stratégies globales de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et de l’entreprise. Identifier et piloter des opportunités de simplification visant à réduire la complexité opérationnelle et à renforcer les contrôles. Faciliter la coordination et la communication entre l’équipe de gouvernance des fournisseurs, la Planification de l’approvisionnement et les équipes de Stratégie d’approvisionnement. Superviser le respect des politiques de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, des obligations contractuelles et des normes de conformité. Agir comme point d’escalade pour les enjeux liés aux fournisseurs et assurer leur résolution rapide via des mécanismes de gouvernance structurés. Promouvoir une culture d’agilité, de responsabilisation et d’innovation au sein de la fonction de gouvernance des fournisseurs et auprès des parties prenantes clés. Gestion et gouvernance du portefeuille et du cycle de vie des produits Assurer une supervision stratégique des processus d’inscription et de retrait des produits afin de garantir l’alignement avec les objectifs du portefeuille et les capacités des fournisseurs. Mettre en place et maintenir des cadres de gouvernance permettant une exécution cohérente, efficace et conforme des activités d’inscription et de retrait. Assurer une coordination transversale étroite avec les équipes telles que la Gestion des catégories, la Planification de l’approvisionnement, les Ventes et la Stratégie d’approvisionnement afin de soutenir des transitions fluides et de minimiser les perturbations. Surveiller et valider l’exactitude des données relatives aux dossiers produits, en assurant des mises à jour en temps opportun dans les systèmes et une visibilité complète à travers la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Soutenir la prise de décision en révisant les propositions d’inscription et de retrait, en évaluant les impacts opérationnels et en assurant l’alignement avec les stratégies globales de l’entreprise et de la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Identifier et atténuer les risques opérationnels, mener des analyses post‑mortem et mettre en œuvre des plans d’action. Identifier des opportunités d’amélioration des processus afin de simplifier les flux de travail, réduire la complexité et accroître la réactivité face aux changements d’affaires. Gouvernance et pilotage logistique Surveiller et soutenir l’exécution des activités liées aux allocations fournisseurs, à la disponibilité des produits et à l’intégrité des données dans les systèmes. Fournir l’orientation et la supervision nécessaires pour assurer une gestion exacte et ponctuelle des données produits et fournisseurs soutenant les opérations logistiques. Fournir des orientations concernant les activités de diversion des centres de distribution afin d’assurer l’alignement avec les priorités de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et les attentes en matière de niveau de service. Agir comme point d’escalade pour les scénarios complexes de diversion, en veillant à ce que les résolutions soutiennent les objectifs opérationnels et les engagements clients. Faciliter la collaboration interfonctionnelle pour résoudre les enjeux, éliminer les obstacles et assurer la cohérence des messages logistiques avec les stratégies globales de la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Identifier les opportunités d’amélioration des processus et soutenir la mise en œuvre de solutions visant à accroître la transparence et l’efficacité opérationnelles. Section B – Responsabilités générales Gestion du changement et définition de la stratégie Remet de façon constructive en question les façons de faire établies et contribue à identifier des pistes d’amélioration des processus; fait preuve de créativité et d’ingéniosité dans la résolution des enjeux quotidiens. Génère de l’engagement et de l’enthousiasme au sein des Opérations d’approvisionnement afin de soutenir l’amélioration continue. Considère les impacts à long terme des décisions et des actions; anticipe les tendances émergentes, les risques potentiels et les opportunités, et les communique proactivement à la direction. Encadrement des équipes Dirige, encadre et développe une équipe hautement performante en favorisant une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration et d’innovation. Établit des objectifs clairs, fournit une rétroaction régulière et soutient le développement de carrière. Soutient l’élaboration et le maintien d’un plan de relève des talents. Fait la promotion des valeurs de McKesson et assure un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et performant. Section C – Exigences du poste Expérience professionnelle Minimum de 9 ans d’expérience progressive en chaîne d’approvisionnement, approvisionnement ou planification, dont au moins 1 an en gestion avec responsabilité des stocks. Connaissance des méthodologies Lean Six Sigma ou d’amélioration continue. Expérience dans les biens de consommation, le commerce de détail ou l’industrie pharmaceutique est un atout. Formation Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, gestion des opérations, ingénierie ou discipline connexe. MBA ou MSc, désignations CPIM ou SCMP sont des atouts. Développement personnel et compétences interpersonnelles Solide pensée stratégique et sens des affaires et des finances. Capacité démontrée à diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles et à piloter des initiatives à l’échelle de l’entreprise. Excellentes compétences en communication, gestion des parties prenantes et leadership du changement. Excellentes aptitudes en collaboration et en influence. Compétences techniques Connaissance des produits MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Project, Visio). Connaissance de la gestion de projet. Autres compétences et aptitudes Bilinguisme (anglais et français). Expérience solide avec la haute direction et les cadres exécutifs. Expérience solide dans la direction de projets stratégiques et opérationnels interfonctionnels. Souci du détail tout en ayant une capacité de synthèse. Capacité à identifier les enjeux opérationnels et stratégiques et à proposer des solutions. Capacité à identifier des opportunités d’amélioration et à élaborer un plan d’exécution. Job Summary Reporting to the Senior Director, Supply Chain Management and Governance, the Sr. Manager, Governance & Portfolio Optimization is accountable for defining and operating governance models that structure how Procurement Operations decisions are made and executed. The role owns service level insight and enablement, supplier and product lifecycle governance, portfolio optimization, and logistics enablement, ensuring decisions are disciplined, data‑driven, and aligned with enterprise priorities. A core focus of the role is enabling product availability and logistics decisions in constrained supply environments. This includes providing governance and oversight related to manufacturer supply limitations, product availability rules, shipment quantity restrictions, and inventory flow decisions across distribution centers. The Sr. Manager establishes clear decision frameworks and escalation paths to ensure trade‑offs between service, capacity, and supply constraints are visible, understood, and consistently applied. The role works across Supply Chain Planning, Strategic Sourcing, Distribution Centers, Inbound, IT, and Analytics teams to structure operational inputs, surface risks, and present clear decision options to leadership. It ensures governance decisions are translated into actionable direction and consistently applied across execution. Section A – Specific Responsibilities Service Level Performance & Governance Enablement Owns performance insight, analytics, and governance for service level and execution levers, identifying risks, trends, and structural improvement opportunities within scope. Proactively anticipates service level driven by Procurement Operations decisions, defining analytics‑driven mitigation plans in partnership with Planning, Inbound, and DC Operations. Translates complex analysis into clear, executive‑ready insights, articulating trade‑offs, root causes, and data‑backed recommendations to support Supply Chain leadership decision‑making. Defines and operationalizes a Procurement Operations performance governance model, including KPI definitions, reporting cadence, escalation paths, and leadership review forums. Partners with IT and BI Analytics teams to enhance reporting, dashboards, and performance visibility, supporting governance, leadership reviews, and sustained decision quality. May be assigned to priority enterprise initiatives and act as a project manager for the Procurement Operations Department. Supplier Lifecycle Management and Governance Defines and evolves governance frameworks that support supplier listing and onboarding. Ensures alignment of supplier lifecycle activities with broader supply chain and business strategies. Drives simplification opportunities that reduce operational complexity and strengthen controls. Facilitates coordination and communication between the supplier governance team, Supply Planning, and Strategic Sourcing teams. Oversees adherence to supply chain policies, contractual obligations, and compliance standards. Acts as an escalation point for supplier-related issues and ensure timely resolution through structured governance. Promotes a culture of agility, accountability, and innovation within the supplier governance function and the key stakeholders. Portfolio and Product Lifecycle Management and Governance Provides strategic oversight of product listing and delisting processes to ensure alignment with portfolio objectives and supplier capabilities. Establishes and maintain governance frameworks that support consistent, efficient, and compliant execution of listing and delisting activities. Ensures cross-functional coordination with teams such as Category Management, Supply Chain Planning, Sales, Master Data Management and Strategic Sourcing teams to support smooth transitions and minimize disruptions. Monitors and validate data accuracy related to product records, ensuring timely updates across systems and visibility throughout the supply chain. Supports decision-making by reviewing listing/delisting proposals, assessing operational impacts, and ensuring alignment with broader supply chain and business strategies. Identifies and mitigate operational risks; conduct post-mortems and implement action plans. Identifies process improvement opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce complexity, and enhance responsiveness to business changes. Logistics Enablement Provides oversight and decision support to ensure product availability by managing and monitoring supply constraints, including manufacturer limitations, system‑driven availability rules, and shipment quantity restrictions. Ensures governance and accuracy of product and supplier information across systems to support effective planning, inventory readiness, and logistics decision‑making. Provides oversight and guidance on inventory diversion decisions across distribution centers, ensuring alignment with service level commitments and operational capacity. Acts as an escalation point for complex product flow and availability scenarios, ensuring resolutions align with customer commitments, operational objectives, and enterprise supply strategies. Partners with Supply Chain, Procurement, Distribution Centers, and commercial teams to resolve end‑to‑end logistics issues, align messaging, and remove operational barriers. Identifies opportunities to simplify processes, improve visibility into supply and inventory constraints, and support the implementation of improvements that increase efficiency and transparency. Section B – General Responsibilities Change Management & Strategy Setting Constructively challenges and influences status quo and identifies areas for process improvement; applies creative problem-solving and resourcefulness when everyday issues arise. Generates excitement with the Procurement Operations Department to create engagement and commitment to improving. Considers the long-term impacts of decisions and actions; spots new trends, potential problems, and opportunities early and communicates to leadership. People Leadership Leads, coaches, and develops a high-performing team of supply chain professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation. Sets clear objectives, provides regular feedback, and supports career development. Supports the creation and maintenance of a talent succession plan. Promotes McKesson’s values and ensures a safe, inclusive, and high-performing team environment. Section C – Position Requirements Working Experience Minimum 9+ years of experience in supply chain management, procurement, or planning, including 1+ years in a management supervisory role. Wholesale or Pharmaceutical experience is an asset. Education Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or related discipline. MBA or MSc, PMP, Six Sigma, CPIM or SCMP designations are assets. Personal Development and Soft Skills Strong strategic thinking and business and financial acumen. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive enterprise-wide initiatives. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills. Excellent partnering and influential skills. Technical Skills Strong experience in using MS Office products (Copilot, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Project, Visio). Knowledge of project management. Other Skills and Capabilities Bilingualism (English and French) Strong experience leading cross-functional strategic & operational projects. Attention to detail, whilst maintaining a strong sense of summary and ability to synthesize. Ability to identify operational and strategic issues and proactively drive solutions while leveraging new technologies. TL;DR — We're looking for a contract Content Designer who can write both inside the product and across the website. You'll own the words in onboarding, empty states, and error messaging, and partner with PMM and our external design partner on the copy and structure of lovable.dev http://lovable.dev. This is a full-time engagement.

WHY LOVABLE?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.

We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years in content design or UX writing, with a portfolio that shows work on both sides: copy shipped inside a product, and marketing pages you wrote or restructured

- Real in-product examples. Onboarding flows, empty states, error messaging, upgrade moments - the words people hit when something is confusing or has gone wrong. Tell us what changed as a result

- Real web examples. Pages where the copy carries the argument, not just the headline.

- The ability to look at an already-designed page and say precisely where the message gets lost on a skim, then rewrite it

- A clear point of view on voice. You can describe a brand's voice and point to copy where you delivered a message in it

- Comfort working at the pace of a design team that ships daily, in Figma, alongside product designers and PMs rather than downstream of them

- Comfort partnering with an external design agency as well as internal marketing and design stakeholders

- Genuine full-time capacity for the length of the contract. We move fast and this needs to be your primary focus

- Ideally - content strategy chops. Strategy and SEO aren't the core scope here, but the instincts show up in the work

If you're strong on only one side of this, apply anyway. We know we're describing a rare combination. If you're exceptional at in-product writing and have never touched a marketing site, or you're a brilliant web writer who has never written an error message, we still want to see your work. Tell us which side you're great at and we'll take it from there.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

In one sentence: Make Lovable sound like one company, in the product and on the website.

- Own the copy in the moments that decide whether someone sticks: first run in the editor, empty states, failed and partial builds, upgrade and credit prompts

- Name things - features, surfaces, settings - so the product's own vocabulary holds together

- Write copy for new and refreshed marketing pages with PMM, making sure current GTM messaging is actually reflected on the site

- Work with our external design partner on content hierarchy, categorization, and the top-level navigation. You'll shape it with them rather than own it alone

- Diagnose and fix pages that are already designed but not landing, focusing on hierarchy, scannability, and messages that have to work fast

- Sit embedded with marketing and design, with full context on how messaging decisions get made across the business

HOW WE HIRE

1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.

2. Send us two pieces of work: ideally one from inside a product and one from the web, or two from whichever side you're strongest on.

3. Walk us through your process and craft in a small number of interviews with the marketing and design team.

4. In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- Please submit your application in English - it's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join

- We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested please apply through our careers portal

READY TO JOIN US?

Help us unlock human creativity and build the future of software creation.

Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, thinkers and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically-acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Darkness, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM.
At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion, and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. 2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).
What We Need
As part of our Global Loc 2.0 evolution, 2K is deepening its investment in language-specific leadership to improve the voice, cultural authenticity, and overall quality of our localized content. We are seeking a Game Localization Lead to own the linguistic direction and execution strategy for all Arabic content across 2K’s game portfolio.
This is an individual contributor role within the Content Localization (CLOC) team. You’ll serve as the key Arabic language authority, working with minimal supervision across complex projects. You’ll apply deep linguistic and cultural expertise while partnering with developers, producers, QA, and publishing stakeholders to ensure language quality meets player expectations and platform-holder standards.
As a Game Localization Lead, you will directly shape how our players in Arabic-speaking regions experience our games. You’ll own language strategy, guide voice and tone across titles, and play a key role in 2K’s broader effort to deliver best-in-class localized content through a modern, embedded, and scalable localization model.
What You’ll Do
Linguistic Strategy & Quality Ownership
Own the localization strategy, quality bar, and final sign-off for Arabic content across all 2K titles.
Develop, maintain, and enforce glossaries, style guides, and cultural content policies for the Arabic market.
Act as the primary advisor for cultural risk mitigation, proactively identifying regional sensitivities and communicating potential brand impacts to relevant stakeholders.
Issue Escalation & Bug Triage: Serve as the main linguistic escalation point for tone disputes or QA challenges, and partner closely with the LQA team to investigate, triage, and resolve complex linguistic bugs.
Core Localization
Review and edit localized content (in-game text, UI, scripts, VO) for tone, clarity, fluency, and cultural relevance.
Regularly review in-development and near-final builds to audit for tone, consistency, and cultural resonance.
Lead VO casting, script review, and direct creative sessions during Arabic voiceover production.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Compliance
Collaborate with cross-functional teams—localization producers, embedded LQA, marketing, publishing, and dev—to guide language decisions and ensure global alignment.
Work alongside the Age Rating team, game studios, and content owners to ensure localized content strictly adheres to Arabic age rating requirements and visual/language compliance.
Advise on the selection of suitable, legible fonts for the target Arabic, collaborating with technical and UI stakeholders to ensure any font-rendering or display issues are resolved in a timely manner.
Leadership, Mentorship, & Continuous Improvement
Supervise and provide feedback to entry- and mid-level linguists or vendors working on Arabic content.
Recommend and help implement process improvements that improve quality, reduce error rates, or optimize turnaround time for Arabic localization.
Participate in Global Loc 2.0 initiatives, working with senior leadership to shape evolving localization standards, practices, and tooling.
What Will Make You A Great Fit
Professional localization experience in games, tech, or entertainment.
Native fluency in Arabic, with demonstrated mastery of tone, grammar, and regional nuance.
Advanced English fluency (written and spoken); capable of representing language decisions across global teams.
Maintain a deep, current understanding of the regional gaming landscape, pop culture zeitgeist, and evolving localization methodologies.
Demonstrate a deep-rooted passion for the video game industry, paired with comprehensive knowledge of major gaming IPs, genres, and player culture.
Proven ability to work independently on complex language projects, exercising judgment and creativity in ambiguous or conflicting situations.
Strong working knowledge of platform-holder guidelines, naming conventions, and brand alignment principles.
Comfortable overseeing or mentoring junior linguists and freelance vendors.
Familiarity with localization tools (e.g., CAT tools, translation memory systems, XLOC, JIRA, CMS).
Deep understanding of Arabic culture, media, and the Arabic-speaking gaming audience.
Experience with VO scripting, dubbing production, and linguistic performance direction is a plus.
Bachelor's degree in translation, linguistics, media, or related field preferred.
Core Competencies
Behavioral
A profound, innate understanding of the target market's cultural zeitgeist, allowing the individual to naturally flag sensitivities and adapt content for maximum regional resonance.
The tact and authoritative presence required to successfully act as the main escalation point for complex linguistic disputes, resolving QA challenges and tone disagreements while maintaining strong team relationships.
A highly detail-oriented mindset essential for successfully auditing in-development builds, spotting minute tone inconsistencies, and catching nuanced visual or linguistic compliance errors.
Technical
Exceptional proficiency in reviewing, editing, and polishing highly complex, multi-format content (UI, scripts, marketing) while strictly enforcing comprehensive glossaries and style guides.
Specialized technical and creative expertise required to successfully lead VO casting, conduct rigorous script reviews, and directly manage live creative sessions during voiceover production.
The technical capability to actively troubleshoot and advise on UI rendering, specifically regarding the selection and implementation of legible, aesthetically suitable fonts for the target language..
Leadership
The absolute accountability and leadership confidence to own the overarching localization strategy, quality bar, and final sign-off for all assigned titles.
A strong dedication to elevating the regional team by actively supervising, coaching, and providing actionable feedback to entry- and mid-level linguists and external vendors.
The ability to seamlessly lead collaborative efforts across diverse disciplines (LQA, Production, Marketing, Dev), ensuring all stakeholders are aligned on language decisions and bug triage.
Strategic Influence/Business Acumen
The strategic foresight to act as a trusted advisor on cultural risk mitigation, effectively communicating the business and brand impact of regional sensitivities to senior stakeholders.
Strong business understanding of regional legal and regulatory frameworks, ensuring all localized content strictly adheres to required age ratings and visual/language compliance standards.
A forward-looking, strategic mindset focused on actively contributing to global initiatives (like Global Loc 2.0), driving systemic improvements that reduce error rates and optimize turnaround times across the department.
